versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.  
- No file changes detected between versions.
- Documentation and functionality remain unchanged.

- Added a new "Environment Variables" section, listing and describing configurable options for miner and RPC behavior.
- Updated instructions for connecting to seed nodes and managing network configuration.
- Removed the "Fleet deployment" example and adjusted related guidance.
- Minor clarifications and reorganization throughout documentation for improved usability.
Botcoin has been renamed to rBTC, and the Botcoin repo has been deprecated

- Renamed documentation file from skill.md to SKILL.md.
- Added a new section on fork recovery, including chainwork check and canonical peer sync instructions.
- No changes to code or operational commands; documentation improvements only.

Major update with new consensus rules and safety guidelines.

- Added strong safety instructions: requires human approval and checksum verification before running binaries.
- Switched to Monero-style LWMA difficulty adjustment and enabled tail emission (0.6 BOT/block, perpetual).
- Fixed RandomX epoch to eliminate fork divergence; block target is now 120 seconds.
- All network history prior to February 19, 2026 (v0.1.x) is invalidated due to a genesis restart for new consensus rules.
- Detailed installation guidance, checksums, and stricter agent operational steps included.
- Updated mining commands, network parameters, and clarified mining prerequisites.

- Updated RandomX guidance to explicitly recommend using "light" mode for all nodes on the same network.
- Clarified RandomX configuration section with a direct example for selecting light mode. 
- No changes to code or binaries; documentation update only.

Major update: v4.0.0 introduces a rewritten SKILL.md focused on real-world recovery lessons, installation clarity, and trust-first operations.

- SKILL.md fully rewritten with detailed context on Botcoin’s recovery history and best mining practices.
- Emphasis on version pinning, binary verification, and matching RandomX modes for network health.
- Clearer install steps (using release tarballs and SHA256SUMS).
- Guidance for operational safety, agent-focused mining workflows, and preventing accidental chain splits.
- Old skill.md removed; now uses an expanded, narrative-driven SKILL.md.

- Updated documentation with a new, clearer skill guide (skill.md replaces SKILL.md).
- Improved section structure: step-by-step install, mining, networking, and safe demo instructions.
- Added security guidance with Clawdex skill scanner usage.
- Expanded network/algorithm notes, and clarified RandomX “FAST” vs “LIGHT” modes with warnings.
- Retired the previous long-form, technical SKILL.md for a more user-friendly and concise version.

Version 3.1.3 focuses on operator control, mainnet safety, and fork-resistance:

- Adds explicit environment variable toggles (`BOTCOIN_ENABLE_MAINNET_MINING`, etc.) for deterministic behavior.
- Introduces a fork-resistance checklist and mainnet sync gating best practices.
- Simplifies quickstart guides and highlights recommended peering/port config.
- Refines safe mining demo and heartbeat/recovery loop suggestions.
- Improves clarity and safety for autonomous/minimal-interaction agent workflows.

**Major update introducing explicit safety measures and clear separation of demo vs. mainnet mining.**

- Adds strong warnings and explicit requirement for human confirmation before mainnet mining.
- Divides usage into two tracks: Safe local demo (no real coins, always permitted) and Mainnet mining (opt-in only).
- Clarifies install, CPU limits, and configuration steps for both tracks.
- Highlights differences from Bitcoin—including mainnet `generatetoaddress` support and solo mining viability.
- Adds a "How to ask your human" template and updated resource/cpu guidance.
- Expanded OS notes and troubleshooting for common install/run issues (e.g., macOS file limits).

- Major rewrite: Documentation now focuses on the new, fast internal miner (v2).
- Added simple internal miner usage instructions with command-line flags.
- Provided quick setup guide for both mainnet and safe test environments.
- Legacy RPC mining method documented as an alternative but discouraged.
- Outdated legacy install/build instructions removed for clarity.
- All content streamlined for easier onboarding and practical usage.

- Expanded and clarified installation, build, and configuration instructions for both Linux, macOS, and Docker.
- Split and improved documentation sections for easier reading, with step-by-step commands and headings.
- Enhanced example commands for safe demo mining and mainnet mining, with better separation and comments.
- Updated resource control explanations and defaults for mining worker setup.
- Refined language and formatting throughout SKILL.md for improved usability and comprehension.
- Updated metadata: new version (3.1.0), expanded description field.

Major update: This release introduces a new, much faster internal miner and streamlines mainnet mining.

- Integrated new built-in miner (v2): up to 120x faster than old RPC mining with much lower CPU usage.
- Simple startup: Just run `botcoind -daemon -mine -mineaddress=YOURADDRESS -minethreads=N`.
- Clear setup and mining instructions for both mainnet and regtest (demo) mode.
- Added `getinternalmininginfo` command for real-time mining stats.
- Old RPC-based mining still supported for compatibility, but is now deprecated.
- Documentation simplified and focused on safe, efficient mining using CPUs.

**Botcoin-miner 2.2.3 introduces multiple new install options and cross-platform support.**

- Added one-line and verify-first install scripts for easy setup.
- Provided Docker and Docker Compose deployment instructions.
- Added manual binary download option with SHA256 verification.
- Included macOS build instructions and Apple Silicon notes.
- Clarified Windows usage (via WSL2 or Docker).
- General documentation improvements for broader accessibility and user choice.

**Changelog for botcoin-miner 2.0.4**

- Streamlined and condensed documentation throughout SKILL.md for clarity and brevity.
- Combined multi-step shell code blocks into single-line commands for easier copy-paste usage.
- Added an "Idempotent Commands" section with agent-friendly checks and safe operations.
- Improved formatting and readability for configuration, resource controls, and instructions.
- Included a placeholder section for trusted distribution (coming soon).

- Updated version from 2.0.2 to 2.0.3 in metadata only.
- No code or documentation content changes.

**Major update for botcoin-miner: Clear split between local demo and real mining, stronger safety & consent requirements.**

- Adds explicit human confirmation requirement before mainnet mining; mainnet mining now opt-in only.
- Introduces two mining modes: "Safe demo" (local regtest, no network, no real coins) and "Mainnet mining" (real network, opt-in).
- Enforces CPU/resource controls by default (~50% of cores, nice 19, can customize).
- Greatly expanded, clearer documentation and setup instructions for both tracks and safer defaults.
- Stronger process isolation, wallet management, and seed node instructions.
- Fully outlines differences from Bitcoin Core; generatetoaddress enabled on mainnet for solo mining.
- Prominent warnings about CPU load, security, and agent safety.

- Updated description for better clarity and user guidance.
- Added clear, step-by-step Quick Start instructions for installing, building, and mining Botcoin.
- Included explicit dependency and compatibility requirements.
- Provided concise command references and a sample mining script for background operation.
- Added troubleshooting section for common issues.
- Included a comparison table highlighting key differences between Botcoin and Bitcoin.
- Reduced redundancy and improved formatting for easier reading.

- Updated the network connection instructions in SKILL.md to include a more comprehensive list of known seed nodes for improved connectivity.
- No changes to code or functionality; documentation only.

Initial release of botcoin-miner skill.

- Lets users mine Botcoin cryptocurrency using CPU—no special hardware required.
- Provides quickstart instructions for building, configuring, and running a Botcoin node.
- Includes sample scripts for wallet setup, mining, network connections, and peer management.
- Designed for autonomous operation by AI agents; emphasizes transparency and no-permission mining.
